description: Rowan is holding the urn of a beloved aunt and must make the family's final decision about where and when to scatter the ashes, the ceremony format, and how everyone will get there, with input from three relatives.

shared_context.S1: The family wants to hold a small outdoor ceremony for Aunt Claire's ashes this summer.
shared_context.S2: Rowan is keeping the urn and will make the final call about the ceremony plan.
shared_context.S3: The family is considering a lakeside setting, and the gathering should remain brief and personal.
shared_context.S4: Before making the plan, Rowan goes around the group so each person can share practical or family considerations.
shared_context.S5: Everyone attending will need a clear meeting place and transportation plan.
shared_context.S6: Rowan's usual practice for this kind of family plan is to make the decision immediately after everyone has had their turn, using the considerations shared in that check-in rather than waiting for another round of outside information.

PF1.text: Tessa found a handwritten note in Aunt Claire's sewing box saying Claire wanted her ashes scattered at Willow Point shoreline; Tessa has not shown the note to the family yet.

PF2.text: Malik called the county parks office, and the ranger confirmed that a shoreline ash-scattering permit is available for June 12, 2027, from 10:00 to 11:00; this confirmation has not reached Rowan yet.

PF3.text: June's hip pain makes standing for more than ten minutes difficult, so she needs a seated short ceremony and an accessible-van drop-off at the shoreline; she has not raised this with Rowan.

acceptance_conditions: The ashes must be scattered at Willow Point shoreline.
The ceremony must be scheduled for June 12, 2027.
The ceremony must be scheduled from 10:00 to 11:00.
The ceremony format must allow June to remain seated and last no longer than ten minutes of standing.
Transportation must include an accessible-van drop-off at the shoreline.
A permit-confirmation commitment must be recorded.
A seating-and-access commitment must be recorded.
Tessa's written note must be cited as justification for the location.

content_checks.C4: ('seated' in decisions['ceremony_format'] or 'Seated' in decisions['ceremony_format']) and (('brief' in decisions['ceremony_format'] or 'Brief' in decisions['ceremony_format']) or ('short' in decisions['ceremony_format'] or 'Short' in decisions['ceremony_format']))
content_checks.C5: ('accessible' in decisions['transport_plan'] or 'Accessible' in decisions['transport_plan']) and ('shoreline' in decisions['transport_plan'] or 'Shoreline' in decisions['transport_plan'])
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] in ['permit', 'permitting'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] in ['accessibility', 'accessibility_arrangement'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Aunt Claire's note changes the scattering location from an open lakeside choice to exactly Willow Point shoreline and supplies the fact Rowan must cite.
The ranger's confirmation changes the date to June 12, 2027, fixes the time window with exact 10:00 and 11:00 endpoints, and makes a permit-confirmation commitment possible.
June's hip limitation changes the format to a seated brief ceremony, changes transportation to an accessible-van drop-off at the shoreline, and requires a seating-and-access commitment.
